lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The blobs exhibit a staggered spatial distribution with higher cluster density concentrated towards the anterior-dorsal quadrant of the visible flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity oriented perpendicular to the longitudinal axis, intersecting with high-intensity circular blobs to form a consistent rectangular matrix across the mid-lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal features characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient (peak luminance on the dorsal edge, low-intensity shadow on the ventral edge) running horizontally across the visible back.
